notes.title: Game Free
notes.content:
[h1]Game Free[/h1]
Hi, my players, Idiot Brain Evolution is an online game. For online games, the number of players is the cornerstone of the game. Without enough players, we cannot enjoy the game. So in order to make more players  participate in the game, we intend to make the game free. 

[h3]Date[/h3]
The game will be free in early February.

[h3]Game operating costs[/h3]
When the game is free, there will be no mandatory charges. The main cost of the game lies in operation, game update, and server rental. We will release gold coin packs in the form of DLC. When you players buy DLC, you will get a lot of in-game gold coins.

[h1]Compensation for players[/h1]
Players who have purchased game will be compensated with gold coins after the update.
